timeline.quote: losing a quarter of their number to the cold, the dark, and the desperate creatures there.

timeline.summary: Kayla leaves New Yotia on a riverboat down the Mardun toward Kroog with Talite mercenaries aboard.
timeline.quote: So she did not protest when a detachment of dark-clad soldiers filed onto her riverboat.
